map.由波长与孔径直径，按 θ = 1.22λ/D 计算光学系统最小可分辨角。: Given wavelength and aperture diameter, compute the minimum resolvable angle of an optical system with theta = 1.22*lambda/D.
map.由波长与 NA 算最小可分辨距离。: Minimum resolvable distance from wavelength and NA.
map.显微镜/镜头分辨率上限。: Resolution ceiling for microscopes and lenses.
map.选高 NA 或短波提分辨。: Use a higher NA or a shorter wavelength to improve resolution.
map.：λ=550nm、NA=1.4（油镜）→ d=0.61×550/1.4≈240n: lambda = 550nm, NA = 1.4 (oil immersion) -> d = 0.61*550/1.4 = about 240nm, the theoretical limit of an optical microscope (about 0.2um).
map.：改用 UV λ=365nm 或 NA 1.5 → d≈149nm；再小须电子/: Switch to UV with lambda = 365nm or NA 1.5 -> d = about 149nm; going smaller requires electron or scanning probe techniques to break the diffraction limit.
map.两物点 Airy 斑中心距≥第一暗环（1.22λ/2NA）即恰可分辨，取 0.6: Two point sources are just resolvable when the center-to-center spacing of their Airy disks is at least the first dark ring (1.22*lambda/2NA); 0.61*lambda/NA is used as the spacing criterion.
map.受衍射极限，光学 ~200nm；超分辨靠 STED/PALM 等绕过瑞利极限。: Limited by diffraction: optical around 200nm; super-resolution relies on STED/PALM to bypass the Rayleigh limit.
